credits.title: Strawberries
credits.overview: Hasna and Meriem leave their native Morocco to work a season picking strawberries in Spain, until abuse and harassment shatter their hopes. Supported by a Spanish lawyer, they must decide whether to speak out against a powerful system.

credits.title: Bad Weather
credits.overview: Ten-year-old Ayoub lives with his family in a modest apartment inherited from his grandfather. As winter begins, his uncle demands his share of the inheritance but the home's only bathroom lies on his side sparking a tense family conflict.

credits.title: Deserts
credits.overview: Longtime friends, Mehdi and Hamid, work for a collection agency. They crisscross the villages of southern Morocco in their old car and share double rooms in shabby hotels. credits.title: Anger
credits.overview: Omar, the miller's son, has been in love with Laila, the daughter of the local landowner, since childhood. In adulthood, Omar has become a promising journalist and writer. He still loves Laila, but she has promised herself to someone else to save her family from bankruptcy...
